body:
Somebody keeps promising the same hour to the nap and to the ambition.

They postpone rest for the want, then postpone the want for rest, and the week turns into a negotiation nobody wins outright.

With the Moon quincunx Lilith, the same person needs recovery and the familiar and also needs the thing recovery keeps deferring.

They never find a clean trade, only weekly adjustments that fit neither need.

Both needs may survive, but whoever keeps making the accommodation quietly decides which one is being starved.
